messages:
marta_support: FYI customer reported a large billed token spike overnight, but their served tokens on the dashboard are much lower. invoice shows ~120k tokens billed between 02:00-03:00 UTC, dashboard served=~18k. attaching minimal repro they ran. can eng/billing help triage?
jeff_sre: thanks, can you paste the example request stream and any x-request-id / trace ids? sounds like continuous-batch/kvcache warmup mismatch we've seen before.
marta_support: customer pasted this snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
headers: {Authorization: Bearer ... , x-customer-id: cust-42}
body: {"model":"rwd-neo-13b","input":"Order summary:\nItem: widget\nQty: 1\n","max_tokens":80}
```
They said they sent 6000 of these over the hour (short prompts, same prefix). invoice shows 120k billed tokens, logs show many METER events with ~20 tokens each. served token logs our side show only ~3 tokens served per request after cache warmup.
sam_billing: pinging billing. do we bill at enqueue or at served time? my assumption: billed tokens are based on metering line when request accepted, not final served tokens. but need to confirm why METER > SERVED by that much.
ops-bot: deploy-billing-agent reported: "metering/ingest: received 6000 events, aggregate tokens=121560" (trace: trac-0192).
jeff_sre: that size diff is consistent with continuous batching prefetch: runtime may precompute KV cache for longer prefixes and charge token cost per prefetch operation across multiple batch slots. essentially the prefetch is counted multiple times while the eventual served responses reuse cached KV so served tokens look lower.
anya_ml: adding context: when prefix_kv_prefetch is enabled, the runtime issues background requests to warm caches using tokenized prefix length. Those warmups are metered as separate operations in the metering pipeline. If metering aggregation is per-operation, it'll show the warmups as billed tokens even if final responses are cache hits. :thinking:
marta_support: customer is confused because their usage dashboard shows served tokens (what they expect). invoice includes warmup prefetch tokens. they want a refund or explanation. any quick mitigation?
sam_billing: short-term options: 1) adjust invoicing aggregation to attribute warmup tokens as internal system operations (requires eng/billing change), 2) disable prefetch for this customer if possible, 3) offer manual credit while we investigate.
jeff_sre: to reproduce locally for engineering: run a load script that sends identical short prompts at high qps with continuous batching enabled. example repro:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 6000); do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "x-customer-id: cust-42" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-13b","input":"Order summary:\nItem: widget\nQty: 1\n","max_tokens":80}' &\
  sleep 0.05
done
```
collect logs with: `grep METER runtime.log | tail -n 200` and `grep SERVED runtime.log | tail -n 200`.
anya_ml: also add header `x-disable-prefix-prefetch: true` to test disabling prefetch behavior; we have a per-customer flag we can flip in the control plane (eng-infra can do).
marta_support: customer asked why dashboard and invoice differ. can we get a short explanation I can send to them?
jeff_sre: suggested copy: "Billing counts tokens for all metered runtime operations, including background prefix/KV prefetch warmups triggered by continuous batching. The dashboard's 'served tokens' view reflects the tokens actually emitted in responses. When many short, identical requests warm the cache repeatedly, metering can record additional warmup tokens which appear on invoices but not in served-token dashboards. We're filing this as an action item to improve visibility and attribution."
sam_billing: I'm okay offering a one-time credit while we fix attribution and add a dashboard line-item for 'prefetch/warmup' tokens. please escalate to eng-runtime & billing-analytics.
ops-bot: ticket created: ENG-4512 "investigate metering vs served token delta for prefix prefetch" (assignee: jeff_sre).
marta_support: customer ok with temporary credit and disabling prefetch while we investigate. i'll ask for exact credit amount after eng confirms what part of billed tokens are warmups. thanks all :thumbsup:
jeff_sre: next steps for eng: 1) pull metering ingestion logs for trace trac-0192 and filter by customer cust-42 2) instrument metering pipeline to tag source=warmup/prefetch 3) add config to flip prefix_kv_prefetch per tenant in control plane. marking notes in ENG-4512.
anya_ml: reassigning to eng-runtime for kernel-level behavior review. also will check if quantization/kv cache ttl extents cause additional duplicate prefetches. :eyes:
